stories.title: AUSL Championship Game 1 Recap — Talons 3, Bandits 1
stories.angle: The Utah Talons defeated the Chicago Bandits 3-1 in Game 1 of the AUSL Championship Series on Saturday afternoon on ABC at Davis Diamond, College Station, Texas. Montana Fouts started and was dominant. The Talons — defending champions who swept the Bandits in the 2025 title series — now lead the best-of-3 Championship 1-0. Game 2 is Sunday July 26 at 2 PM ET on ESPN. If the Talons win Sunday, they become the first team in AUSL history to win back-to-back championships. If the Bandits win, Game 3 is Monday July 27 at 7 PM ET on ESPN2. Davis Diamond sold out for all three potential games.

stories.title: Montana Fouts — Game 1 Masterpiece in the Championship
stories.angle: Montana Fouts stepped onto the ABC mound rested, prepared, and sharp. She had not pitched since July 20 — five days of rest before the biggest start of her career. The result: a dominant Game 1 performance as Utah defeated Chicago 3-1 in the first professional softball game ever broadcast on network television. Fouts enters the series with a 7-4 record, 2.36 ERA, 63 strikeouts, and the AUSL single-game strikeout record at 12. In two regular-season starts against Chicago this year, she went 2-0 with a 1.19 ERA. Now she has a third win over the Bandits — and a chance at a third on Sunday to close the series.

stories.title: PGF Nationals — Athletics Mercado and AZ Rising Are Champions
stories.angle: Two national champions were crowned Saturday at Deanna Manning Stadium, Bill Barber Park, Irvine, California. Athletics Mercado won the 16U Premier national championship on a walk-off hit by Teuila Jaelynn Eteaki, defeating Hotshots National-Galloway 3-2. AZ Rising won the 18U Premier championship via run rule over Lady Dukes Lamar — Goose Goodwin (committed to Northwestern) starred on the mound against Jordynn Parnell (committed to Duke) of Lady Dukes. September 1 — the date when D1 coaches can first directly contact Class of 2028 recruits — is now 37 days away. Every player who competed at PGF Nationals this week was on someone's recruiting board.

stories.title: Talons One Win Away — What a Back-to-Back Would Mean
stories.angle: The Utah Talons are one win away from becoming the first team to win back-to-back AUSL championships. No team has done it. The Talons swept the Bandits in 2025. They beat Chicago 3-1 in Game 1 on Saturday. Game 2 is Sunday July 26 at 2 PM ET on ESPN. The Talons (No. 1 seed, 16-9 in the regular season) won four of five regular-season matchups against the Bandits. Hannah Flippen — 2025 AUSL Defensive Player of the Year — anchors a defense that has been the backbone of this team all year. If Utah wins Sunday, they are the standard-setters for what a championship program looks like in the AUSL.

stories.title: History Was Made on ABC — What Saturday Meant for Softball
stories.angle: Whatever the viewership number is, it is now the benchmark. Game 1 of the AUSL Championship Series between the Utah Talons and Chicago Bandits aired Saturday afternoon on ABC — the first professional softball game ever broadcast on U.S. network television. Utah won 3-1. Montana Fouts pitched. Davis Diamond was sold out. ABC, which carries the Super Bowl and NBA Finals, carried professional softball. Every professional softball broadcast from here forward gets measured against this afternoon. The sport had its national moment. The question now is what comes next.

x_posts.text:
Today, professional softball was on ABC.

First time. Network television. Utah Talons 3, Chicago Bandits 1. Davis Diamond. A sold-out crowd.

Whatever the viewership number is, it is now the benchmark. The sport had its moment. #AUSL #softball
